record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain newest-128 histories but use clipped cumulative position IDs min(position,32); replace pooling with 0.8*h_t+0.2*causal_mean_t. Add a jointly learned input projection of log1p(item training count), standardized using training items only, alongside the existing frequency scaling. Train with 0.8*BPR+0.2*pointwise logistic loss on the same positive/negative pairs. Coarse positions and mean pooling capture stable interests, frequency features provide context, and logistic supervision anchors otherwise relative scores. Preserve HSTU blocks and optimizer settings; checkpoint feature statistics and update predictor generation.

category_rationales.rationale: Retain newest-128 observed histories, clip cumulative position IDs at 32, and blend each state with its causal mean to represent stable interests. The generated predictor imports this same updated model class.
Combine 80% pairwise BPR with 20% pointwise logistic supervision on the same sampled pairs, retaining valid-target weighting and optimizer settings.

Add a jointly learned input projection of standardized log training-item counts alongside existing frequency scaling. Persist feature values and normalization statistics in each category checkpoint, and require the generated predictor to restore them.
